about: Silent cells of the refereed checkpoint (push/c15-referee-r14-independent-checkpoint/CHECKPOINT_R15_REFEREED.md, one referee) with the round-15 outcomes of campaign/STRATEGY.md section 4.0 version 5. Classes on which the record is silent; not leads. Written by push/c16-repair-owed-record-r15/patch_engine.py

nodes.name: Silent cell U3: identification classes, tested by relaxing one input
nodes.statement: Silent cell of the refereed checkpoint: a read class on which the obstruction record neither defeats nor supports a device. Not a lead; no lane has a registered reason to expect a crossing here. Read sets: {zeta's own functional equation, ordinary Dirichlet series} (Hamburger); degree one with the functional equation, an ordinary series and the Euler-product axiom (Kaczorowski-Perelli); {positivity of Lambda, unimodular parameters at every rational prime, ordinary series}; {functional equation, pole at 1 only, Lambda_G >= Lambda} (Lemma L). No control can lie in such a class, and the record holds identifications there and no inequality. U1 {FE, GEOM} and the SIZE branch of U2 are cells of it. Entry test for a device: its decisive step must fail when one input is relaxed inside a family where the conclusion is false, at a named step with the size it needs: ZQ (ordinary series relaxed continuously), SG (positivity relaxed one-sidedly), NR-q and T-NR in Laurent form (ordinary series relaxed discretely), U, THIN, DEL (functional equation), WT (functional equation at all heights), E_a (unimodular parameters), sign twists (positivity). A step that is only an identification scores 0. Round-16 lane: c16-qa-filter-silent-cells-geometric-nodes (paper filter). No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Silent cell U2-POS: zeta's functional equation with Lambda_G >= 0 and exact atoms (lemma POS-FE)
nodes.statement: Silent cell of the refereed checkpoint: a read class on which the obstruction record neither defeats nor supports a device. Not a lead; no lane has a registered reason to expect a crossing here. Read set: {zeta's own functional equation, pole at 1 only, finite order, -G'/G a Laplace-Stieltjes transform of a non-negative measure}. Neither constructed nor excluded: a G not proportional to zeta with these properties would be a control and close the cell; a proof that G = c zeta would be an identification (cell of U3, score 0); only a quantitative form (a measure bounded below by -eps times a reference measure forces every zero within f(eps) of the line) would be a non-identity statement, and ZQ shows the dependence cannot be better than eps of order eta^2 + d^2 for an absolutely continuous defect. Known: with Lambda_G >= Lambda the conclusion G = c zeta holds (Lemma L, relative to Landau's theorem), and the pole clause is necessary (referee control G_+ with real poles in (0, 1)). First controls: ZQ, SG, G_+, NR-q. Round-16 lane: c16-pos-fe-u2-positivity-rigidity. No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Silent cell U4: joint functionals of zeta and twists outside the five closed types
nodes.statement: Silent cell of the refereed checkpoint: a read class on which the obstruction record neither defeats nor supports a device. Not a lead; no lane has a registered reason to expect a crossing here. Read set: a functional of zeta and its twists that is not (i) a function of finitely many ratios L(chi)/zeta, (ii) a Gram or Hankel-block form of the pair of unitary symbols, (iii) a twist-transfer Weil form, (iv) a sign functional of dictionary DJ, (v) invariant under a common pointwise scaling of the members. Examples left: quotients at different points, a logarithm of one member alone, kernels with polar terms, triples read through the group law at several points. State: dictionary DN closed as measured at the nine-class and six-class tiers; the canonical tier {T-NR, E_a, HEAT} is undecided at float64 (67,138 nodes); Lemma J1' has one derivation and no referee. Lift rules for any search: LIFT_RULING.md (T-NR, E_a, HEAT canonical). First controls: T-NR at a split prime, backward heat with equal and unequal tau, E_a. Round-16 lane: c16-dn-canonical-tier-ball-conversion (compute). No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Silent cell U6 (a): Hecke eigen-objects with parameter rho in rank >= 2, non-Borel or metaplectic
nodes.statement: Silent cell of the refereed checkpoint: a read class on which the obstruction record neither defeats nor supports a device. Not a lead; no lane has a registered reason to expect a crossing here. Read set: an inequality on an eigen-object attached to a zero outside rank one. Closed already: the LRS-type count in rank one for any cover, level and vector (pole minus gamma pole equals 1; relative to an unopened source for the pole position); the twelve catalogued inequalities for torus parameters; isobaric sums with cuspidal data are argued closed, not proved. A device that reads theta-orthogonality must fix the level or read the Whittaker functional on the whole representation (control NR-vec) and must use the factor zeta(u) in every square-index coefficient. No candidate object is on file. First controls: EIS-w, BLS, NR-vec. No statement about zeros of zeta.

nodes.name: Silent cell U8: single-object kernel sign conditions beyond the searched range
nodes.statement: Silent cell of the refereed checkpoint: a read class on which the obstruction record neither defeats nor supports a device. Read set: a sign condition on the theta-normalised kernel of one object with order above 4, more than three parameters, nodes outside [-2.6, 2.6], or another normalisation (beyond the searched range of rows G36 and P55 in the obstruction table). Excluded from the cell by proved statements: minors on one lattice (T-NR with c >= 2 passes); Polya-frequency orders of the xi-kernel (E_a passes); monomial inequalities with non-negative quadratic weight for kernels without polar terms (backward heat inherits them; one derivation, no referee). A search in this cell follows the pre-registration rules of the compute lanes and the canonical lifts T-NR, E_a, HEAT. No statement about zeros of zeta.
